summary: @ornikar/browserslist-config preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute opaque bundled payload
details: This package is advertised as a static browserslist configuration (main exports a 3-line string), but declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style obfuscated (hex identifier renaming like _0x488df8, per-function string/method dictionary objects, function-wrapped call indirection) and downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/..., extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it 0755, and invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 728 KB single-line file starting with the `// @bun @bun-cjs` marker (Bun-precompiled bytecode-adjacent output not runnable under Node), using randomized short identifiers, a large numeric constant array, and a shuffled string-array decoder. The payload is only reachable via the freshly downloaded Bun binary, so its behavior is opaque to Node-based review. A browserslist config has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or an obfuscated install-time payload; this is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern with intentional evasion of Node-source inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
